lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6Co2 (Mn3Co) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Co and Mn centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Co is surrounded by 12 Mn neighbors, while Mn has 4 Co and 8 Mn neighbors, with distances from 2.53 to 2.68 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Co- and Mn-centered polyhedra.
